about: FSVR's VOP3 programs ported from microcode to C++, one row per chip program the FS1R loads. A row is done when tools/vop3_native_check <key> reports identical: bit for bit against the interpreter, on every type that runs it. docs/vop3_native/README.md is the brief.

programs.start_from: git show a9cb37d^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_filter.h (the measured 4-pole ladder and 2-pole state-variable structure), docs/filter.md
programs.note: Whole program transcribed and tidied: every step written out, the registers and cells named, the page and lane schedule in the header. The three things that move with a parameter are read from the core (coefficients, the sixteen tap steps setType points at a slot's filter output, and the gated block that only the host's trigger opens). Checker says identical on all six types, 57600 native passes.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of No Effect, Hall1, Hall2, Room1, Room2, Room3, Stage1, Stage2, Plate, White Room, Tunnel, Basement, Canyon
programs.note: Whole program transcribed and tidied: every step written out, the registers and cells named, and the three groups the steps form (the send and the host's two tone filters, the four delay taps, the three more reads and the two writes) opened in the header. No DELAY_ROUTES entry matches reverb types 0 to 12, so nothing rewrites this window's constants or delay offsets: a read of c.coef[] and c.slot[] under all thirteen types shows the same preset thirteen times, and the code reads them live all the same. The three tap coefficients t[9], t[10], t[11] and the three index loads are zero under every one of those types, so the four tap products are zero; the reads and the cell moves still happen and are all in the transcription. Checker says identical on 13 types, 124800 native passes, and ctest is green. Next row is dly-m08.

programs.start_from: no old model: the aux window has no parameters
programs.note: Eight four-step units (0x0e8-0x107) and a six-step tail (0x108-0x10f). Each unit is a first-order smoother of one cell: state r[61..66,101,102], difference r[31..34,43..46], read by the base program at 0x046, 0x050, 0x056, 0x05f, 0x089, 0x092, 0x0d8 and 0x0e0, and the pole is the gain word on its second step, which is rom::STEPS_OUTPUT_GAIN, written 21 by setOutputGain at boot and 0x18 by the window's own preset, so it is read from c.coef[st] and not folded in. The tail clears the running value into m[40] and m[41] and takes m[17] to out[8]. No control step in the base or reverb program, so m_skip is reachable only from the 0x1xx windows.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Auto Wah, Touch Wah
programs.note: 72 steps 0x158-0x19f, identical over 2 types and 19200 passes. Groups: the two channels' two order-1 EQ shelves each (WAH_FILTER, WAH_FILTER_2, WAH_FILTER_3, WAH_FILTER_4), the cutoff word with the Auto Wah's LFO depth on it (WAH_CUTOFF, WAH_DEPTH), the one-pole that smooths it into t[9], the highpass touchWah designs (WAH_HPF), the resonator's input summer with WAH_SENSE, the sensitivity level off WAH_ATTACK, the accumulators r[114]/r[115] and the feedback m[54]/m[55] that close the loop, the lowpass (WAH_LPF), the dry and wet (WAH_PAN) and the tail's six published reads. The two types' own words differ where no list writes them: the Auto Wah's 0x169 and 0x16a are zero, so its highpass is silent, and its 0x171 leaves m[58] at zero, so only the Touch Wah's sensitivity path runs.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Phaser1, Phaser2
programs.note: 72 steps 0x158-0x19f, identical over 2 types and 19200 passes. Groups: the two channels' EQ shelves (0x158-0x165, the four PH_FILTER lists), the left cascade's swept gain (0x166, 0x16f, 0x174-0x175: 128*PH_FB[0] + m[8], squared, then to the fourth less 128 into t[10]), the eight section weights (0x167-0x16e, each scaling one cascade section into a running sum that 0x16a and 0x16e double into r[120] and r[121], so with exactly two words at HALF each sum is its two open sections added), the diffuse tap (0x170-0x173 over r[120], r[121], r[114] and r[117] into r[119]), the feedback into the left cascade (0x176-0x179 into m[54]), the right gain on the same shape (0x17a, 0x17d, 0x189, with m[56] the ROM's zero written by 0x180), the left cascade's five first-order sections (0x17b-0x17c on m[54], 0x17e-0x17f into m[55], 0x181-0x188 on r[110] to r[112]), the right cascade's input r[113] (0x18a-0x18c) and its five sections (0x18d-0x19b), and PH_PAN's dry and wet into r[15] and r[16] (0x19c-0x19f). What separates the two types: phaser1() puts the phase shift 258 in both feedback words and its width at 0x179 alone, phaser2() splits 258 and 242 and puts the width at 0x178 and 0x18B, so the width reaches r[121] under Phaser2 and m[54] under Phaser1, and with the ROM's own words left at 0x172 the diffuse tap is r[114] under Phaser2 and zero under Phaser1 with Diffuse off. ctest: 3 of 3 pass.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Ens Detune
programs.note: 72 steps 0x158-0x19f, identical over 1 type and 9600 passes. Groups: the two LFO cells m[8] and m[9] into six registers (0x158-0x163: r[123] and r[126] the cell doubled, r[124] and r[1] its absolute value, then four class-1 loads leaving r[125] and r[2] at max(0, 64 + the LFO) as the two base delays and r[123], r[124], r[126], r[1] at max(0, |2 * the LFO| - 24) and max(0, |2 * the LFO| - 40) as the four crossfade weights, both channels the same two, 0x15b, 0x15f and 0x163 reading the slots 0x56 to 0x58 and publishing them into m[22] to m[24] on the next steps); the four detune words DETUNE_DET at 0x164, 0x16c, 0x173 and 0x17b, each loading the delay index and its fraction into a t (t[10], t[12], t[14], t[7]); the two channels' input and two order-1 EQ shelves (0x165-0x16b and 0x174-0x17a, DETUNE_LOW_SHELF and DETUNE_HIGH_SHELF and their copies), which also read the first tap pair's two slots at the index just loaded; the four interpolated taps (0x17c-0x17d, 0x17f-0x180, 0x186-0x187, 0x18a-0x18b, each a linear interpolation of two words one sample apart, the eight words captured into m[56] to m[63] in the order left, right, left, right by pair); the two crossfades (0x183-0x184 and 0x18e-0x18f) weighting the two taps by t[9] and 1 - t[11], and by t[13] and 1 - t[15]; the two copies at 0x191-0x194 on the ROM's near-unity and zero words, which are copies because 0x19a reuses r[119] for what goes into the left line; and the outputs and the two delay writes at 0x195-0x19f, DETUNE_PAN's four words with the variation's wet word 8186 and no dry, so each output is 0.9993 of its tap, 0x19a latching the left one for the slot 0x66 write at 0x19b and 0x19f writing the right into the slot 0x67 itself. Each channel's two taps are 256 * w * 64 samples apart, w the word the two detune steps share: 572 samples on the ROM's own 0.034943, which is what the index holds with the LFO cell at zero. The LFO cells reach +-128 (chips/vop3.cpp's lfo() scales by RANGE), so a tap's index sweeps 256 * w * 128 samples and the weights top out at 232/16384 and 216/16384. 0x16d writes r[1], not r[126], which is what makes the two channels' weights symmetric. ctest: 3 of 3 pass.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of 3-Band EQ
programs.note: 72 steps 0x158-0x19f, identical over 1 type and 9600 passes. Groups: EQ3_A the summed left input and the right one (0x158-0x159, 0x169); the two channels' three cascaded order-2 bands, six five-word sections b0, b1, b2, -a1, -a2 off EQ3_LOW_SHELF2, EQ3_PEAK, EQ3_HIGH_SHELF2 and their _COPY lists (0x15a-0x15e, 0x15f-0x163, 0x164-0x168 and 0x16a-0x16e, 0x16f-0x173, 0x174-0x178); EQ3_B the two outputs (0x179-0x17b); and the tail, class 0 and idle but for the reads of the slots 0x63, 0x64 and 0x65 at 0x18f, 0x193 and 0x197, the captures that take them into m[31], m[32] and m[33] five steps later, and the two LFOs published into m[11] and m[12]. Each b0 step closes its section with a route (a shift of one on the two lower bands, three on the high one) that restores the factor designFilter's 2048 * (16 >> scale) took out, the route multiplying the whole section sum, so the five words stand for the designed coefficients. Under the type's own preset all three gains are 0 dB and each band's numerator word pair equals its denominator pair (left low 1.0, -1.949341, +0.950012 against the same two on its own output; middle 1.0, -1.952026, +0.971985; high 1.0, -0.437500, +0.047852), so every section is all-pass and the window is transparent until a band moves: arithmetic off the dump's k values, not measured. The MODE parameter is the only one that touches EQ3_A and EQ3_B: stereo gives r[103] = L, r[111] = R and one chain per output; mono gives r[103] = (L + R) / 2 and both outputs from the left chain with r[117] multiplied by the zero at 0x17B, which is what the type's preset holds. No step reads at a delay index and none writes the delay RAM. ctest: 3 of 3 pass.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Hall, Room, Stage, Plate
programs.note: Hall, Room, Stage and Plate's 72 steps, transcribed and named in one session. Structure: the mono sum r[103], the host's var::REVERB_HPF and var::REVERB_LPF, two EffectHost::diffusers() units (0x170-0x173 over the slots 0x5C/0x59, driven by the filtered mono, and 0x178-0x183 over 0x60/0x5B, driven by the pre-delay tap m[57]), the FB_LEVEL width mix at 0x177 into 0x5D that var::REVERB_PRE reads back at 0x5A, two damping one-poles (0x184-0x186 into r[106], 0x187-0x189 into r[108]), the two comb gains at 0x19b and 0x19f into 0x66 and 0x67 with the four early reflections combDelays2() hangs off them, and var::REVERB_PAN into r[15] and r[16]. Two cells stay at zero and src/fs1r/native/var_m10.cpp says why: m[59]'s capture at 0x180 finds no read in captured()'s five-to-eleven-step window (the read at 0x17f is step 383 and the window ends at 379), and m[54]'s only writer is 0x18a, whose M_PREVIOUS sits on a class-0 step that step() returns before. Both are transcribed as step() stands, not simplified. Matched the interpreter on the first check, no difference to chase. vop3_native_check var-m10: identical, 45 types, 432000 native passes; the 45 are the four variation types 25 to 28 plus the 41 insertion types the sweep visits while the window still holds this program. ctest: 3 of 3.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Thru, Chorus, Celeste, Flanger, Symphonic, Delay LCR, Delay L,R, Echo, CrossDelay
programs.note: Done. The 96 steps 0x1a0-0x1ff in six groups: the LFO cell m[12] through a rectifier into three accumulators (r[121], r[125], r[123]) that name the three delay lengths in t[9], t[10] and t[11] and the index the taps read at; the left channel's three bands (ins::LPF_MOD, ins::EQ_MOD, ins::HPF_MOD) with the slots 0x6E/0x6F and 0x70/0x71 read on the way; the other two tap pairs 0x72/0x73 and 0x75/0x76, their four interpolations into r[79], r[119], r[81] and r[120], the fixed taps of 0x68 and 0x69 latched at 0x1cc and 0x1ea and spent on the slots 0x74 and 0x7A, and the right channel's bands with ins::DELAY_CURVE and ins::DELAY_CURVE_COPY; the dry and wet ins::MOD_WORDS into r[17] and r[18] and the two delay lines' writes at 0x1fb and 0x1ff. Two things the next row should know: a writer without w1[13] spends the latch an earlier latching step left (0x1d3 and 0x1eb), which is what puts the fixed tap into the slot 0x74 instead of the step's own value, and a step that carries w1[13] and is a writer drops it and writes its own value; and every slot the insertion window touches holds the same offset until a handler programs one, so its taps and its writes land on one RAM word and a difference there hides for thousands of passes before a capture picks it up. One reading to check separately: the three accumulators are seeded at 0x1A7, 0x1AA, 0x1AF and 0x1B1, whose words belong to ins::PC_FB and ins::LFO_DIR_STEPS (the ensemble detune) and the phaser's tables, and none of chorus(), flanger(), symphonic(), delayLCR(), delayLR(), echo() or crossDelay() writes them, so under those types the index is zero and the taps sit at the offsets the host wrote. vop3_native_check ins-m00: identical, 55 types, 528000 native passes.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Rotary SP, 2WayRotary, Tremolo, Auto Pan, Ambience
programs.note: Done. Straight transcription first (7512c76, identical on the first run), then the tidy pass: every step named from the program's own words and the tables the host writes through, in ten groups. Both check runs identical, 5 types, 48000 native passes; ctest 3 of 3. What the 96 steps compute: the window's LFO cell m[12] through a rectifier into four accumulators r[121], r[124], r[122] and r[123], each a delay length in samples whose integer part is an index the taps read at and whose fraction interpolates a tap pair; eight swept taps at the slots 0x6d to 0x74, two per index, captured into m[56] to m[63] and interpolated into r[119] to r[122]; two channels of three tone-shaping bands each (ins::LPF_ROT, EQ_ROT, HPF_ROT and their _C copies) into r[72] and r[78]; four amplitude gains; the wet sums under ins::ROT_PAN; the dry mix under ins::TREM_WORDS and ins::ROT_WORDS; r[17] and r[18] the two outputs; and the two delay lines' writes at the slots 0x7e and 0x7f. Two things worth carrying to later rows: 0x1fa latches the tremolo mode's mix for the write at 0x1fb, which spends that latch, while 0x1ff carries w1[13] and drops it instead, so the two lines take different values; and ins::LFO_DIR_STEPS, ins::PC_FB and ins::PC_MIX name steps inside this range that no handler of these five types writes, so under them those words are the preset's.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Phaser1, Phaser2
programs.note: Done. The 96 steps in six groups: the two signals in and the four shelf words of each channel (0x1a0-0x1b2), the swept coefficient of each cascade (0x1b3-0x1c2, the LFO rectified by ins::PH_DEPTH, offset by ins::PH_FB, squared through t[10] and t[11]), the ten stage words ins::PH_STAGES and the diffuse taps ins::PH_DIR (0x1b7-0x1c6), the fourth power off the offset (0x1c7-0x1ca), the cascade inputs through ins::PH_WIDTH1/PH_WIDTH2 (0x1cb-0x1ce and 0x1e1-0x1e3), the twelve allpass sections (0x1cf-0x1e0 on t[10] over r[74]-r[79], 0x1e4-0x1f5 on t[11] over r[81]-r[86]) and the mix ins::PH_WET into r[17] and r[18] (0x1f6-0x1f9). No delay RAM: every w0 of the program is zero. Three things the listing misread and the checker caught: 0x1a2 has sub set, 0x1ac has asel 3 not 0, and 0x1f4 and 0x1f5 were missing. vop3_native_check ins-m02 identical, 2 types, 19200 passes; ctest green.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of ER 1, ER 2, Gate Rev, Revrs Gate
programs.note: Done. The 96 steps in eight groups, named from EffectHost::earlyReflections() and the ins:: tables it writes: the mono mix of r[7] and r[8] into r[67] at the ROM word 0x2000 each and doubled, then ins::ER_HPF's biquad over r[67]-r[70] (0x1a2-0x1a6) and ins::ER_LPF_2's over r[71]-r[74] (0x1ac-0x1b0), ins::ER_LPF's one-pole High Damp filter on the twentieth tap into r[75] (0x1b1-0x1b3), with the first five right-channel taps read between the steps (0x1a0-0x1b3); two diffusion rows off r[73] and their own allpass points, the cells m[18] and m[19], into the slots 0x6d and 0x6e and out at r[119] (0x1b4-0x1bb); the ten left gains ins::ER_STEPS[0..9] on the cells m[22]-m[31], which the base program's steps 0x118-0x194 capture from ins::ER_SLOTS' even entries, summed into m[43] (0x1bc-0x1c5) and written to the slot 0x71 by the class-0 step 0x1c7 out of the latch 0x1c5 leaves; the ten right gains ins::ER_STEPS[10..19] on the cells m[56]-m[63], summed into m[44] and written to the slot 0x76 at 0x1db (0x1d2-0x1db); the two sums through ins::ER_DIFF_SLOTS' allpass points, the slots 0x65 and 0x75, into r[121] and r[120] (0x1dc-0x1df); the last two allpass-and-line rows on the slots 0x77/0x79 and 0x78/0x7a (0x1e6-0x1ed); r[119] plus ins::ER_FEEDBACK[0] on r[75] written into the slot 0x7b, ins::ER_SLOTS[21], which is where erPattern() measures the ten right taps from (0x1ee-0x1ef); ins::ER_WET's four words into r[17] and r[18] (0x1f1-0x1f6). Eleven delay reads and nine writes; eleven class-0 steps that only count, two of which write the slots 0x7c and 0x7d with zero every pass. No t register, no class 1 or 3, no delay index, no compare, no control step, no gate. vop3_native_check ins-m03 identical, 4 types, 38400 passes; ctest green.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of A-Wah+Dist, A-Wah+Odrv, T-Wah+Dist, T-Wah+Odrv
programs.note: Done in one session: read the dump, transcribed the 96 steps, three transcription slips found by bisecting the native against the interpreter (the shift-3 route is RSCALE[3] = 16 not 8; 0x1bd and 0x1c1 take m2m 1 so m2 is the cell, not xv), then the header rewritten to the structure the arithmetic shows. The wah and the distortion are two chains, not one: the EQ feeds the resonator r[74]/r[75] whose state the band filters, the drive and the waveshaper take, and the output mix puts the resonator's signal back beside the shaper's. vop3_native_check ins-m04 identical, 4 types, 38400 native passes; ctest 3/3.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of HM Enhncer, Noise Gate, Compressor, Comp+Dist, Distortion, Overdrive, Amp Sim
programs.note: Done in one session: read the dump, generated the straight transcription of all 96 steps straight from the program words, and it came out identical on the first build, so there was nothing to bisect. Reading, from rom_tables.cpp's ins:: names and the six handlers fx_dispatch.cpp routes to msb 5: 0x1a0-0x1af the two inputs and the two channels' input filters ins::DIST_INPUT and DIST_INPUT_C (five words each, b0, b1, b2, -a1, -a2, with the two z^-1 words on the steps that carry rcopy) plus the drive's first three words; 0x1b0-0x1c1 the shaper's gain word, ins::HM_DRIVE into r[120] and r[119], ins::DIST_LEVEL summing and rectifying the two channels into m[49], the detector's states r[75], r[76] and r[121] under ins::DYN_RELEASE, and ins::DYN_ATTACK smoothing m[42], m[43] and m[44] into t[9]; 0x1c2-0x1cb ins::DIST_BAND[5] to [11], the four-word monomial chain then the polynomial sum, the level times t[9] passed on in t[10] and t[11], and ins::DIST_DRIVE[3] into r[79]; 0x1cc-0x1db ins::DYN_THRESHOLD into r[123] and the three tone filters ins::DIST_PRE, DIST_PRE_C and DIST_EQ into r[85]; 0x1dc-0x1ec ins::DIST_MODE and the output filters ins::DIST_OUTPUT into m[45] and DIST_OUTPUT_C into m[46], with ins::DIST_WET mixing into r[17] and r[18]; 0x1ed-0x1ff the gain curve's eight class-1 breakpoints off r[123] (a quarter, a half, one, two, four, eight, sixteen, sixty-four, negatives clamped to zero), ins::DYN_RATIO's eight weights, the biased total into m[42] and the two dry signals. Two details worth keeping: r[124] and r[125] carry the level times the smoother early in the pass and the curve's last two breakpoints later in it, and m[3], m[7] and m[13] are taken for the base program and read nowhere here. No delay RAM and no control step anywhere in this program.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Pitch Chng, Ens Detune, 3-Band EQ
programs.note: Reading done. 96 steps 0x1a0-0x1ff, 3 types (ins-07 Pitch Chng, ins-08 Ens Detune on pitchChange/ensembleDetune, ins-21 3-Band EQ on threeBandEq). The ROM's own word lists name every step: LFO_DIR_STEPS={0x1A0,0x1A8,0x1B0,0x1B7} the four fractional read positions (two index loads with idxw, each feeding a t register); PC_SLOTS={0x7E,0x68,0x69,0x6A,0x6B,0x7F,0x6C,0x6D,0x6E,0x6F}; EQ7_A/B/C and _A_C/_B_C/_C_C = {0x1BF,0x1BB,0x1BC,0x1BD,0x1BE},{0x1C4,0x1C0,0x1C1,0x1C2,0x1C3},{0x1C9,0x1C5,0x1C6,0x1C7,0x1C8} and the 0x1CC-0x1D0, 0x1D1-0x1D5, 0x1D6-0x1DA copies: six order-2 sections, three bands per channel, each b0,b1,b2,-a1,-a2 as designFilter writes them; PC_FB={0x1F9,0x1FE,0x1A7,0x1AA,0x1AF,0x1B1} the delay feedback; PC_MIX={0x1BA,0x1CB,0x1CA,0x1E9,0x1EE,0x1EB,0x1F0}, PC_WET={0x1E8,0x1ED}, PC_VOICE1_A/B, PC_VOICE2, EQ3_LEVEL={0x1EA} the mix. Eight taps: 0x68/0x69 read at one position with memop 2 and 4 (two adjacent words) and m[56]/m[57] crossfaded by the t[10] fraction; 0x6A/0x6B the same by t[12]; 0x6C/0x6D by t[14]; 0x6E/0x6F by t[3]. The reads sit inside the EQ steps (0x1BB, 0x1BF, 0x1C3, 0x1C7 are b1, b0, -a2, -a1) and the ten captures land 5 steps later. The two delay lines are 0x7E and 0x7F, written at 0x1FB and 0x1FF off r[81] plus the feedback; 0x7B and 0x7C are published for the base program. No control steps. Old vop3_effects.h models this as two detuned taps crossfaded with floating-point interpolation and a shelf+peak, and has none of these words.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Lo-Fi
programs.note: Done in one session. Straight transcription first (136eba0, identical on the first run, so nothing had to be bisected), then the tidy pass with the header rewritten to the structure the arithmetic shows; both check runs identical, 1 type, 9600 native passes, ctest 3 of 3. The 96 steps 0x1a0-0x1ff are a bit crusher: 0x1dd-0x1ff are 35 zero class-0 steps, so the program proper is 0x1a0-0x1dc. In order: r[81] climbs 1/256 a pass and ins::LOFI_RATE is the threshold 0x1a3 compares it against, so the cskip-6 block 0x1b0-0x1b3 latches m[42] = r[70] and zeroes r[81] (a sample and hold); the input is r[67] = ins::LOFI_GAIN * (r[7] + r[8]), then ins::LOFI_HIGH_SHELF (order 1) and ins::LOFI_LPF2 (order 2, a biquad) into r[70]; 0x1b4 takes m[42] - r[79] as the quantizer's input; ins::LOFI_BITS is the step in m[56]; 0x1b7, 0x1bb, 0x1bd and 0x1c1 clamp that input to +-step around a dead zone from zero to the step (0x1bc is a cskip 1, so the negative branch 0x1bd-0x1c3 only runs when 0x1ba skipped, and 0x1c0's cskip 4 guards 0x1c1); r[80] and r[79] are two integrators around the quantizer, which is where the error shaping comes from and 0x1b4 is where r[79] comes back; ins::LOFI_LEVEL and ins::LOFI_OUT scale it into r[72]; then ins::LOFI_FILTER (order 1), ins::LOFI_FILTER_2 (order 2), ins::LOFI_FILTER_3 (order 1) and ins::LOFI_HIGH_SHELF_2 (order 1, the emphasis switch) into r[78]. Four things the next rows should know: the wet signal r[119] is r[78] one pass old, read at 0x1a4 before 0x1dc writes it, so the wet is a sample behind and both outputs share one crushed signal and differ only in their dry side; the three cells m[3], m[7] and m[4] take the serial inputs of pages 13, 13 and 14 and nothing in this window reads them; no step touches the delay RAM, a t register or the index queue, and every w0 is zero; and ins::LOFI_RATE is not a rate in samples at all but the threshold the counter r[81] is compared against, so its period is 256 * 128 * the word. The old vop3_effects.h model is a floating-point decimation, quantizer and two-pole lowpass and has none of these words.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the model of Wah+DS+Dly, Wah+OD+Dly
programs.note: Done: 96 steps transcribed and read into blocks. vop3_native_check ins-m12: identical, 2 types, 19200 native passes; ctest 3/3. The reading: an input EQ of two cascaded order-1 shelves per channel (ins::LPF_WAH/HPF_WAH and the _C copies), a difference-and-smooth level follower on the wah output (r[80], r[81]), the resonator r[78] whose loop gain t[9] is the loop's own signal so the resonance sweeps with the level, the four-tap delay line of ins::WD_SL read into m[60]-m[63], ins::WAH_PEAK and ins::WAH_LPF2 over it, and ins::WD_LEVEL into r[17]/r[18]. Noted: ins::WAH_BAND[5] and ins::WD_FB[0] are both 0x1dc, and the word ins::WAH_LPF2 lists at 0x1e6 is not the one that step multiplies by.
